/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json,itertools
p=json.load(open(\"input.json\"))
a=sorted(p[\"actions\"],key=lambda x:x[\"id\"])
best=None
count=0
for bits in itertools.product([False,True],repeat=len(a)):
 chosen=[x for x,b in zip(a,bits) if b]
 ids=[x[\"id\"] for x in chosen]; s=set(ids)
 cost=sum(x[\"cost\"] for x in chosen)
 if cost>p[\"budget\"]:continue
 if any(not set(x[\"requires\"])<=s for x in chosen):continue
 if any(set(pair)<=s for pair in p[\"incompatible\"]):continue
 count+=1
 losses={x[\"id\"]:max(0,x[\"base_loss\"]-sum(x[\"reductions\"].get(i,0) for i in ids)-sum(b[\"reduction\"] for b in x[\"bonuses\"] if set(b[\"actions\"])<=s)) for x in sorted(p[\"scenarios\"],key=lambda x:x[\"id\"])}
 worst=max(losses.values()); weighted=sum(losses[x[\"id\"]]*x[\"weight\"] for x in p[\"scenarios\"])
 key=(worst,weighted,cost,ids)
 if best is None or key<best:
  best=key; result=dict(actions=ids,cost=cost,scenario_losses=losses,worst_loss=worst,weighted_loss=weighted)
result[\"feasible_portfolios\"]=count
print(json.dumps(result,separators=(\",\",\":\")))'"
